biography_events.event: A profound LSD trip in 1964 ("about 350 mices"), where he "hit the Dies Irae."
PKD publishes Ubik — the half-life novel he would later read as accidental scripture.
In 1970, PKD wrote 4 letters to Sandra Miesel, turning the correspondence into a sustained discussion of the science-fiction community, money and royalty problems, and family and relationship strain.

In 1973, PKD wrote 7 letters to Diane Cleaver, turning the correspondence into a sustained discussion of the science-fiction community, family and relationship strain, and publishing and career pressures.
Seeing the "Eye of Horus" as the judge of the 1974 revolution.
The 1974 "second pass" regarding the Xerox letter and Nixon's fall.
The 1974 induction of "inner anamnesis" by the Golden Fish sign.
The 2-74 "withdrawal of assent" which caused 1974 California to disappear.
